Hi Alex / Logan — putting the CS plan on this thread. I drafted a staged implementation plan that maps milestones to owners and deliverables. See the attached 90d-implementation-timeline.xlsx and the high-level summary below.

High-level staging (proposed):
- Discovery & acceptance criteria (Week 1–2) — Owner: Marissa Cole (CS) / Alex (Customer)
  - Deliverables: access to sandbox, initial test prompts, KPI targets
- Integration & test harness (Week 3–5) — Owner: Skyline Eng (TBD) / Redwood Eng support (Ben Carter)
  - Deliverables: API keys, sample payloads, latency SLA targets, failover plan
- Clinical validation & accuracy tuning (Week 6–9) — Owner: Clinical Ops (Customer) / CS (Marissa)
  - Deliverables: validation report, eval prompts, regression thresholds
- Pilot & phased rollout (Week 10–12) — Owner: Customer product + CS enablement
  - Deliverables: go/no-go checklist, monitoring runbook, escalation contacts

Key dates aligned to your targets: integration window targeted week of Aug 16 (we flagged a one-week float), clinical validation mid-September, and Go-live goal Oct 1.

Risks & mitigations:
- Resource constraints on Skyline Eng: propose a 2-hr/week engineering office hour with Ben Carter to unblock integration tasks.
- Data residency / audit evidence: Monica will take the security evidence lead and will provide the SOC2 summary and audit links within 48 hours of request.

Next steps (action items):
- Alex: confirm API owner + sandbox point-of-contact (reply inline)
- Alex: confirm whether integration week can float +/- 7 days
- Logan: finalize commercial SOW redlines and circulate to procurement
- Redwood: deliver finalized MAP and SOW redlines by Thu EOD (June 4)

Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
